label: Curved Welt 2.5 cm
description: The curved welt at 2.5 cm is the most common barchetta specification, placing it at the standard English welt width but with the Italian-inflected arc that makes it instantly recognisable. The combination of familiar width and distinctive curve gives this pocket wide appeal: it is at home on both city suits and sport jackets, and it is the specification most Italian tailors default to when a client asks for 'Neapolitan' character. The upward curve creates a natural shelf that showcases a folded pocket square to exceptional effect.
